ai_summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited has announced a record date of September 22, 2026, for its final dividend payment and a subsequent book closure period from September 23 to 29, 2026. This intimation is for the company's 47th Annual General Meeting and dividend distribution, making shareholding by the record date crucial for eligibility. The document outlines routine corporate actions and does not present any immediate red flags.
